tools.name: search_supplement_ingredients
tools.description: Look up ingredients Picardo can put in a custom supplement by name, for example "magnesium glycinate", "vitamin D3" or "fish oil". Takes several names at once. Returns each ingredient’s ID for draft_supplement_formula, the unit its amount is measured in, a typical daily amount and the most one daily

tools.name: draft_supplement_formula
tools.description: Turn a list of supplements into one custom supplement and a link to review and buy it on picardo.health. Pass each item as the person named it, with its amount and unit, and the ingredient_id from search_supplement_ingredients. Give the amount in the ingredient’s own unit from search; grams, milligr
